question_text: Convert 0.75 to a fraction in simplest form.

hint_ladder.title: Isulat bilang fraction na may denominator 100
I-simplify ang fraction
hint_ladder.text: Hanapin ang GCD ng 75 at 100, which is 25. Hatiin ang numerator at denominator sa 25.

hint_ladder.title: I-check ang sagot
hint_ladder.text: 3/4 ay simplest form dahil 3 at 4 walang common factor maliban sa 1. Tama ang option C.

A.text: You might have chosen A because naisip mong 0.25 pero 0.75 ito, na-misread mo lang.

B.text: You might have chosen B because tinantiya mo 0.75 as 0.5 kaya 1/2, but the exact conversion is 3/4.

C.text: Correct. 0.75 = 75/100 = 3/4 after dividing numerator and denominator by 25.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 7/10 = 0.7, pinaikli mo lang ang decimal without proper conversion.

next_time_rule: Para maging fraction ang decimal, isulat sa denominator na 10, 100, 1000, tapos i-simplify gamit ang GCD. Tandaan: 0.75=3/4, 0.5=1/2, 0.25=1/4.
